source:
@@U04180@@
Who's behind this?
Whom do we thank?

@@U04182@@
Who else, Sire,
but that exalted Master,
the necromancer of Norcia,
who has your welfare at heart!
He’s deeply disturbed
by the forces deployed against you.
In gratitude, he hopes to bring you victory
even if it costs him his life.

@@U04184@@
All Rome cheered as I
passed in pomp through the city.
I was someone, I said to myself,
and wanted to prove it,
and so, without plan,
I decided to rescue that
great white beard from the flames.
I spoiled those clerics their fun,
nor did they thank me for it.
And now after all these years
I reap the reward of that happy impulse.

@@U04186@@
Generous deeds bring generous rewards.
But look up there!
I dare say he'll send you a sign
whose meaning will soon be made clear.

@@U04188@@
I see an eagle hovering in midair,
and a griffin in hot pursuit.

@@U04190@@
Watch closely!
This appears a good omen.
translation:
@@U04180@@
这背后是谁？
我们要感谢谁？

@@U04182@@
还有谁，陛下，
但那崇高的师父，
诺尔恰的死灵法师，
谁把你的福祉放在心上！
他深感不安
由针对你部署的部队。
出于感激之情，他希望为你带来胜利
即使这会让他付出生命的代价。

@@U04184@@
全罗马都为我欢呼雀跃
盛况空前地穿过这座城市。
我是一个人，我对自己说，
并想证明这一点，
所以，在没有计划的情况下，
我决定拯救它
火焰中的大白胡子。
我破坏了那些神职人员的乐趣，
他们也没有为此感谢我。
这么多年之后的现在
我收获了那种快乐冲动的回报。

@@U04186@@
慷慨的行为会带来丰厚的回报。
但是抬头看那里！
我敢说他会给你发一个信号
其含义很快就会清楚。

@@U04188@@
我看见一只鹰在半空盘旋，
还有紧追不舍的狮鹫。

@@U04190@@
仔细观察！
这似乎是一个好兆头。
